statements.t: At the effective time of the merger, each issued and outstanding share of LCI common stock, par value $0.01 per share, other than certain excluded shares, will be converted into the right to receive 1.2440 shares of the Company’s common stock, no par value, plus cash in lieu of fractional shares.

In connection with the pending merger, the Company expects to incur additional transaction and integration-related costs, including legal, financial advisory, accounting, consulting, regulatory, filing and other related costs, some of which will be incurred regardless of whether the transaction is completed.
The Company expects to fund merger-related costs from cash on hand, cash from operations and/or borrowings under the revolving credit and term loan facility (the “2024 Credit Facility”).
We expect total program costs of approximately $4.5 million and annualized savings of approximately $10.0 million upon substantial completion of the program in the second quarter of 2027.
We estimate that RV industry retail unit sales decreased 14% for the three months ended September 27, 2026 compared to the prior year period.

While we estimate RV industry retail unit sales for the first nine months of 2026 decreased by approximately 14% compared to the first nine months of 2025, we estimate that retail unit sales exceeded wholesale unit shipments during the period as RV OEMs maintained lower production volumes.

We estimate that marine industry retail powerboat unit sales decreased 10% and 6% for the three and nine months ended September 27, 2026, respectively, compared to the prior year periods, primarily due to the current macroeconomic environment faced by the end consumer, such as economic uncertainty and volatile oil prices.

The Company will continue to assess its liquidity position and potential sources of supplemental liquidity in view of operating performance, current economic and capital market conditions, and other relevant circumstances.

estimates.t: There have been no material changes to our critical accounting policies which are summarized in the MD&A in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025, filed with the SEC on February 19, 2026.

estimates.name: OTHER — Seasonality
estimates.t: Manufacturing operations in the RV, marine, powersports and MH industries historically have been seasonal and at their highest levels when the weather is moderate.

statements.t: Purchases of property, plant and equipment totaled $19 million in the third quarter of 2026, highlighting the Company’s investment in technology, advanced automation, and other initiatives that are expected to enhance our long-term operating strategy.

“The benefits of the expanded products and solutions we bring to our customers, in alignment with our engineering and design capabilities, are intended to compound over time and we believe they will enhance our financial performance while allowing for better partnerships with customers to help address product affordability for the end consumer.

In addition, we are investing in engineering and emerging technologies, including prudent AI expenditures, that we expect will deepen our connection to the markets we serve, sharpen our ability to collaborate with OEM customers, and help shape the next generation of experiences for outdoor enthusiasts.

As we begin to shift our focus to 2027, we remain excited about the value-added opportunity related to our pending all-stock merger with LCI Industries, which we believe will enhance our existing strategy and vision as well as the long-term value proposition for our customers, our team members, our shareholders, and the communities we serve.

Finally, I want to thank our team members for their unwavering commitment to Patrick’s BETTER Together values and executing against our strategic initiatives, which we believe will drive long-term profitable growth and value for our stakeholders.”
